title: Analysis of a Surface Crouzeix-Raviart Element for the Stokes Problem
summary: Recently, increasing attention has been paid to finite element discretizations of vector-valued flow problems posed on curved surfaces. In this work, we study a surface Stokes system defined on a two-dimensional manifold embedded in three-dimensional space. The surface velocity field is approximated using a nonconforming Crouzeix-Raviart finite element on a polyhedral approximation of the surface, while the pressure is discretized by piecewise constant functions.
